teaser: "You're the one who always knows what to do," someone says, half joking, half not. Life path 1 asks for self-reliance and bold, unaccompanied vision; ESFJ is built for warmth, duty, and the steady work of holding a group together. Put the two in one person and you get someone who leads by taking care of everyone first and themselves last, who wants to be in charge of the room and also wants the room to need them. The pull between those two is the whole reading.
